structuredContent.reading: Finite decision tree under the supplied policy. Policy edges select actions; transition edges describe outcomes. Terminal probabilities sum exactly to 1. This is not policy optimization.

provenance.unit: exact probability and session-relative milliseconds; one complete finite sequential session under the supplied policy
provenance.reducer: Unfold decisions and timed events into a prefix tree; multiply exact edge weights; sum unique terminal masses
provenance.question: What terminal distribution and deadline-violation probability follow from the supplied policy?
provenance.prompt: Render the session MDP and terminal probabilities in MCP; terminal states must add to one.
provenance.eventSource: Checked session text and resolved overlay; Generative.compile paths and schedules
provenance.boundary: One complete finite sequential session, including zero-mass paths; obligations observed until each terminal time
